competitiveTarget: Neighborhood pages must surface the actual in-boundary homes for sale plus a full KB (kinetic-brutalist) design treatment matching the city and community pages — live single-family market data, boundary map + pins, subdivisions ledger, and live activity no competitor surfaces at neighborhood granularity.
note: KB (kinetic-brutalist) design language — Phase 9 wave 3 (docs/KB_CONVERGENCE_ROADMAP.md). Mirrors the community page section order and reuses the SAME section library (components/site/kb/*), fed neighborhood-scoped DAL data, never forked (ci:kb-single-source G50). KbNav + KbFooter carry chrome. Body lives in main.kb-root. City-fallback: when the neighborhood's own monthly price series is too sparse (<8 non-null monthly points OR <2 calendar years), the market chart falls back to the parent city's series with chartScopeLabel set to '{City} (city)' (§0 honesty).

requiredComponents.name: KbNav
requiredComponents.section: chrome — transparent-over-hero top bar + full-screen menu. Inside .kb-root.

requiredComponents.name: KbSectionTracker
requiredComponents.section: tracking — fires the neighborhood page-view + powers section/interaction analytics (page contract).

requiredComponents.name: MetadataBlock
requiredComponents.section: AI-citability — Breadcrumb + Neighborhood Place + market Dataset JSON-LD.

requiredComponents.name: KbBreadcrumb
requiredComponents.section: breadcrumb — KB-styled Home > {City} > {Neighborhood} hierarchy (visual; JSON-LD is in MetadataBlock).

requiredComponents.name: KbHero
requiredComponents.section: hero — full-bleed VERIFIED neighborhood or city hero photo with labeled regional fallback, neighborhood name in Amboqia, plain-language search, live stat row.

requiredComponents.name: KbAbout
requiredComponents.section: about — editorial intro (data-driven prose from neighborhood.description) + quick-facts ledger. Suppressed when KbResortOverview has verified rich content (avoids duplicate overview prose).

requiredComponents.name: KbResortOverview
requiredComponents.section: rich overview — KB rebuild of the pre-KB CommunityRichContent. Verified overview prose + at-a-glance facts + drive times + amenities from getResortCommunityContent (data/resort-community-{citySlug}-{neighborhoodSlug}.json). Renders nothing when no config.

requiredComponents.name: KbMarketHud
requiredComponents.section: market — verdict stamp, KPI grid, median-close chart with city-level fallback when neighborhood series is sparse.

requiredComponents.name: KbFeatured
requiredComponents.section: featured homes — poster grid of top-priced in-boundary active listings.

requiredComponents.name: KbListingMap
requiredComponents.section: map — MapLibre point map with boundary polygon and in-boundary listing pins.

requiredComponents.name: KbExploreTowns
requiredComponents.section: ledgers — reused twice: once for the subdivisions-within-neighborhood ledger (each linking to /subdivisions/{slug}), once for the Explore-other-cities list.

requiredComponents.name: KbActivity
requiredComponents.section: activity — live new / price-cut / pending / sold rows for the parent city.

requiredComponents.name: KbArticles
requiredComponents.section: guides — recent blog posts scoped to the parent city (getRecentBlogPosts).

requiredComponents.name: KbSell
requiredComponents.section: sell CTA — What is your {Neighborhood} home worth?

requiredComponents.name: FAQBlock
requiredComponents.section: faq — verified market Q&A + FAQPage JSON-LD.

layoutComponents.name: SiteHeader
layoutComponents.section: hidden on ^/cities/[slug]/[neighborhoodSlug] via HideChrome — KbNav renders instead.

layoutComponents.name: SiteFooter
layoutComponents.section: hidden on ^/cities/[slug]/[neighborhoodSlug] via HideChrome — KbFooter renders instead.

removedComponents: VideoTourRail (not present — video tours surface through KbFeatured .video)
CommunityRichContent (rebuilt as KbResortOverview, fed by getResortCommunityContent)
